name: AV by Dave (video engineering concept demos → Instagram page)
head: DaveHomeAssist/system-by-dave branch demos-hosting (PR #360); demos/ in that repo is now the source of truth
statusReason: Demos hosted: PR #360 adds /demos/ (hub, frame-sync, fault-finding) to systembydave.com with the public shell, canonical/social metadata, CSP, self-hosted fonts, sitemap entries, vendored GSAP, optional Umami events and a post-completion email ask (both inert until config.js is filled). All site gates pass locally; both pages verified interactive and in capture mode. Awaiting CI and merge; Dave must supply the Umami website ID and the email form action.
nextStep: Merge PR #360 when green; Dave fills demos/config.js (Umami website ID; email provider form action; optional checklist URL); then set the bio link to https://systembydave.com/demos/?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=profile&utm_campaign=launch&utm_content=profile and post.

findings.finding: Existing story cards are textbook figures with no hook; the picture is secondary. Direction v1 inverts priority: hook and picture first, fact second, citation last.
Hook size must be 100 px at Archivo width 80 with ≤ 20 characters per line to fit the 950 px core; 136 px / width 88 overflows (measured 1237 px).
Reels safe-zone pixel figures differ across third-party guides; system designed to the strict 14/35/6 percent case pending Meta confirmation.
Archive currently stores editions as JSON inside one HTML file; reel pipeline needs per-edition folders. Archive restyle deferred until after pilot.
v1 palette (warm near-black, cream paper) read as brown; Archivo + JetBrains Mono rejected. Replaced by three explorations; B overflow at 168 px fixed to 150 px four-line hook (measured).
Static cards and style explorations rejected as boring. The product is now interactive, narrated concept demos built with GSAP; one plain sentence per step, animation proves each sentence (mom test).

GSAP gotcha: a tweened property named 'delay' is swallowed as the tween's own delay option; renamed to 'wait'. Wait is measured at the hand-over tick, not at screen arrival, so it stays inside 0–1 frame in minimum mode.

Every-state check found a story bug (tearing began at step 2 before 'plug it in'), frames spawning over the CAMERA label, pipeline labels under frames, drops falling through a caption, stacked arrivals, and copies spawning on stage-1 frames. All fixed; the waiting room is now modelled as a frame store that keeps its frame and outputs copies, which is also more accurate.

GSAP's ticker stops when the browser pane is hidden, which silently invalidated one check run (zero drops over a 70 s soak). The demo now has a manual clock (gsap.ticker.sleep + gsap.updateRoot) behind ?drive, and the checker flags stalled runs.
Name 'House Reference' rejected as an insider-only joke. Parked; plain-English options due once the format is settled.

Auto cuts scheduled on GSAP's clock; first step rendered synchronously so frame 0 carries the hook; camera pre-armed so the tear lands at 0.8 s. capture.mjs steps the manual clock per frame, screenshots the stage, encodes with ffmpeg; cover = tear + 8 frames. Runs in house-reference-capture:pw1.63 on Dominic (~5 fps render).

First renders ran the step schedule ~2× fast: gsap.ticker.sleep() is not a manual clock because the ticker wakes when animations are created; headless Chromium's rAF advanced timelines on top of hr.advance(). Fixed with gsap.ticker.remove(gsap.updateRoot). Local checks missed it because the hidden browser pane has no rAF. Checker now records step-change times.

Second concept demo built: design/demos/fault-finding.html (troubleshooting). Fact: a cable swap also re-plugs the port, so one swap cannot separate a damaged cable from an unreliable port; AJA Support FAQ 7308 (U-TAP) says try at least two different cables and two different ports and a known-good cable. Demo models four faults, a shrinking suspects list computed from observations, undo as a test, swap-all as the anti-pattern. Every-state check: 3,520 samples, 0 overlaps/outside/screen leaks/errors.

The scheduled 08:00 daily run (another session) appended edition 9 to the archive at 08:06 with a different troubleshooting fact (Equalizer Reach Is Not a Cable Guarantee, AJA FiDO 3G manual) and story card 009. The demo was relabeled edition 010 to avoid colliding with the record; the archive was not modified by this session.

Checker made demo-agnostic (presses every #play control, sets sliders min/mid/max, random-press soak; tear element optional). Cuts are index-based so a cut can skip a step; pages declare hr.coverAt. Step actions scheduled via later() are cancelled on step change.
Name decided by Dave: AV by Dave. Brand line on demos and reels is 'AV BY DAVE · <edition>'. House Reference retired as a working title.

Stage One research (Dave's, Socialinsider 2026 datasets) applied: main reel = full ~35 s run; cuts open on the failure at frame zero with the question set in over the motion at 0.5 s; CTA overlays the final picture (no end card). Carousel-for-saves and categorizing covers noted as follow-ups.

Re-render verified: frame-sync main 35 s (tear on frame 1, question in by 0.9 s, steps at 5/9/13/18/24/29 s), teaser 13 s; fault-finding main 35 s (dead screen pulsing from frame zero, steps at 4/9/15/20/25.5/30 s), teaser 14.5 s. CTA replaces the subtitle under the hook in the last 3–3.5 s so it never covers the picture.

Hosting: demos moved into system-by-dave under demos/ (hub + two pages). Site contracts required: skip link first, .sbd-site-return breadcrumb, shared nav CSS/JS, canonical, description, theme-color, CSP meta, og/twitter set, no Google Fonts on sitemap routes (fonts self-hosted as latin woff2 subsets), vendored GSAP. demo-shell.js lays the stage out around the bar and completion panel; in ?drive/?auto the shell is hidden and layout is unchanged (verified: step times identical, teaser re-rendered on Dominic from the synced tree).

Regression found: frame-sync had lost its NEXT click handler and arrow-key listener in the 10-17 cut rework, and the every-state sweep passed anyway because it never asserted a step changed. Restored; checker now presses NEXT and fails on a stuck step (findings.stuck).

decisionsForDave.question: Email provider for the post-demo ask
options: A. Buttondown (recommended): plain-HTML form action https://buttondown.com/api/emails/embed-subscribe/<username>, field 'email'; free tier historically up to 100 subscribers (verify current pricing)
B. Kit (ConvertKit): paste the HTML embed's form action + field name into config.js
C. Something else: give me the form action URL and the email field name

decisionsForDave.question: Umami Cloud
options: A. Create a free Umami Cloud (Hobby) account, add systembydave.com, paste the website ID into demos/config.js (recommended)
B. Plausible instead (paid): I adapt demo-shell.js

decisionsForDave.question: Numbering: the daily run owns the archive sequence (it wrote 009 today). Should demos follow the archive numbers (one demo per archive fact) or run their own sequence?
options: A. Demos follow the archive: next demo animates the archive's current fact (recommended)
B. Demos run their own sequence (010, 011…) independent of the archive
C. Replace the archive's 009 with the two-cables fact
decisionsForDave.unlocks: how the 08:00 run and the demo pipeline connect

decisionsForDave.question: Is the interactive narrated demo the product (reel = screen capture of it, page = the demos themselves)?
options: A. Yes, build one demo per fact (recommended)
B. Demos as a bonus, cards remain primary

decisionsForDave.question: Which visual direction?
options: B. Broadcast: cool graphite, international orange, Barlow Condensed caps (recommended, with C's track-color bar borrowed)
A. Signal: neutral black, white, red/cyan, Unbounded
C. Track Color: saturated ground per track, black type, Bricolage Grotesque
